text:
Before the meal the tray held a toasted sandwich (looks like French toast or a grilled sandwich with ham or salmon and tomato), a glass of milk, and a glass of water. After the meal the plate is empty except for crumbs, and the milk and water look untouched.

So the person ate only the sandwich. It looks like two halves on a small plate, made from seeded bread with a filling of ham or salmon and tomato, possibly cheese. I estimate about 180 g and about 420 kcal.

The milk level looks about the same before and after, so I counted none of it. The water has no calories.

{"kcal": 420, "mass_g": 180}
